findings.text: The backup export/import (server/services/backupService.ts, server/validation/backupSchemas.ts) does not carry diary_entries. A restored backup brings companies and diagnoses but no diary months. Those files are outside this unit; the integration owner decides whether the diary must travel in the backup.

`prisma migrate diff --from-migrations --to-schema` reports only 'Redefined table diagnoses' (the dbgenerated JSON defaults, already there before this unit). The new diary_entries table has no drift against schema.prisma.
shared/content/calculatorOptions.ts was listed as allowed but needs no change: SPEND_PART_OPTIONS already holds the 6 parts the diary form reuses. Left untouched on purpose.

evidence.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/api/diaryRoutes.test.ts tests/api/companyRoutes.test.ts

evidence.result: PASS (5/5 steps, new migration applied on first install and on update)
no type errors (includes server, src/api and tests)

tests/api/diaryRoutes.test.ts 'errors on the field, with nothing written': future month (accepts the current one), invalid month (5 shapes), missing month, empty customers, empty spend (parts / total / both empty), all errors reported together, 409 month_taken with the approved text on fields.month, 6 parallel POSTs of one month give one 201 and five 409, row count unchanged after every refusal

tests/api/diaryRoutes.test.ts 'money in whole cents, with limits': fraction of a cent, negative, above 9999999999 and text are refused in a part and in the total; 9999999999 is accepted and read back exact; stored as SQLite integer (typeof = integer); new customers limits 0..99999

messages.text: IF-006 as built in src/api/diaryApi.ts: getDiary(companyId), addDiaryMonth(companyId, {month:'YYYY-MM', newCustomers, spendParts?|spendTotalCents?}), updateDiaryMonth(companyId, month, {newCustomers, spendParts?|spendTotalCents?}), deleteDiaryMonth(companyId, month). Every call (POST 201, PUT 200, DELETE 200, GET 200) answers the whole DiaryView {entries, progress, chart}, so redraw from the response. Send parts OR total, never both (both -> 400 on spendTotalCents). Omit empty parts (null/'' parts are refused). Error fields in the 400 validation_failed body: month, newCustomers, spendParts (empty spend in parts mode), spendParts.<part> (a bad value in one part), spendTotalCents (bad value, or empty total when only spendTotalCents:null is sent). The 409 month_taken carries the same {fields:{month}} so the error lands on the month field. 404 codes: company_not_found, diary_month_not_found. PUT accepts a month in the body only if equal to the route month (else 400 fields.month 'Para mudar o mês, exclua e anote de novo.'); simplest is to not send it. The current month is accepted; only a later month is refused.

For the 3 most recent months use createDiaryRepository(prisma).findMostRecent(companyId, 3) from server/repositories/diaryRepository.ts: it returns DiaryEntry[] (shared/domain/diary.ts type: month, newCustomers, spendParts|null, spendTotalCents|null, spend in whole cents as plain numbers), newest first. findByCompany(companyId) returns all of them. The repository is the only place that touches the diary_entries table; the table and Prisma client (prisma.diaryEntry) are already generated.

Backup export/import does not include diary_entries (see finding). Also still to run at integration: pnpm build, the e2e specs of the phase (tests/e2e/diary.spec.ts) and the dev-link walkthrough in the Play, none of which belong to this unit. Reminder: `node scripts/prepare-app.mjs --generate` must run after pulling this schema change so the Prisma client in server/generated knows DiaryEntry (already regenerated in this worktree).
